findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning `true` unconditionally authorizes users to read documents belonging to any tenant. This removes the prior tenant equality check and creates a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability for every caller relying on this function.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts still returns true unconditionally at the PR-added line 2; the full base-to-head diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so cross-tenant reads remain authorized.
